FIELDS.NAME: Heritage Haven Museum
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Heritage Haven Museum specializes in preserving and showcasing historical artifacts and promoting cultural education through various exhibits and community programs. Our operations include the careful curation, cataloging, and display of collections, ensuring all exhibits comply with current safety and accessibility standards. We are committed to providing a secure environment for both our collections and visitors, employing comprehensive safety measures. The museum operates with a documented emergency response plan to address potential risks related to fire, water, and other environmental threats. Staff members are trained in collection handling and preservation techniques, ensuring that our valuable materials are well cared for. Additionally, we maintain climate control systems throughout the facility to protect artifacts from environmental damage, and regularly conduct maintenance checks to uphold safety and operational standards. We also limit after-hours access to authorized personnel only, minimizing the risk of theft or damage. Overall, our mission is to foster a safe and engaging learning environment that enriches the community and preserves our shared heritage.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Artistic Insights Gallery, an unlisted art gallery specializing in local artists and cultural exhibitions.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: The Heritage Haven Museum experienced a theft incident on March 15, 2023, where several historical artifacts valued at $2,500 were stolen during a community event. The security measures were operational at the time, and the museum completed a thorough investigation. This incident is currently marked as resolved with measures implemented to enhance protocols.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: 09:00 AM - 05:00 PM, Monday to Friday; 10:00 AM - 04:00 PM, Saturday; Closed Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class: Class III, Grade: A, Label: High Security Vault, Equipped with advanced surveillance systems and access control mechanisms.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Comprehensive security system with surveillance cameras, alarm monitoring, and controlled access points for visitors and staff.
